qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: Melanin pigment synthesis and granule localization
rationale: All members concern melanin production, its MITF-driven and metabolic regulation, its albinism defect, or pigment granule positioning, unlike confusables centred on melanosome assembly, lysosomal acidification, other MITF programmes or UV-driven melanocyte proliferation.

qualifier: iron/heme scavenging and suppression of host defences
name: Mycobacterial iron scavenging and host defence suppression
rationale: Members are Mtb strategies for acquiring iron and heme, altering host energy metabolism and ion flux, and suppressing nitric oxide, autophagy and apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on blocking phagosome maturation, acidification and membrane repair.

qualifier: maturation and virion assembly rather than entry
name: Viral protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: All members cover post-translational processing of viral proteins and their assembly at the budding site, while the confusables concern virion attachment, endocytic entry and entry regulation.

name: Glutathione synthesis and recycling, including enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, catabolism, transport and its cystine/glutamate supply, plus inherited defects of GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH and ACY1, distinguishing it from transsulfuration/selenium and ROS-detoxification confusables.

qualifier: cytochrome c release, apoptosome and SMAC-IAP steps
name: Mitochondrial apoptosis via cytochrome c release and apoptosome
rationale: Members span BAX/BAK-driven outer membrane permeabilization, cytochrome c and SMAC release, IAP neutralization and apoptosome caspase activation, whereas confusables add BIM, BMF, NOXA, PUMA or BID activation upstream.

name: Lung branching, alveolar maturation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lung branching and lobe growth, pneumocyte differentiation, surfactant metabolism and its inherited dysfunctions, while confusables emphasize trachea, diaphragm, lung mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Cardiomyocyte depolarization and AV-His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members concern the depolarizing phase of cardiac action potentials and impulse propagation through the AV node, His bundle and Purkinje fibres, unlike confusables on repolarization phases or SA-node pacemaking and gap junctions.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis and angiogenic growth factor production
rationale: Members regulate endothelial proliferation, migration and branching in sprouting angiogenesis and the production of VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2, whereas confusables focus on Tie2/VEGFR2 receptor signalling, endothelial activation and apoptosis, or negative regulation of sprouting.

name: Sweet, bitter and umami taste perception
rationale: All members are perception of sweet, bitter or umami taste, distinguishing the theme from confusables covering sour taste and olfaction.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
qualifier: adaptor cascades of FGFR, ERBB and MET including point mutants
name: Receptor tyrosine kinase adaptor signalling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
rationale: Members are FGFR, ERBB, MET, IGF1R and ALK/LTK adaptor (SHC, GRB2, FRS, PLCG, PI3K) cascades and RAS/RAF/MEK mutants feeding ERK and AKT, whereas confusables emphasize alternative MAPKs, AKT2 metabolic output, or RTK fusions and amplifications in cancer.

name: Redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism, glutathione and cystine handling, and positive and negative regulation of ferroptosis, whereas confusables centre on NFE2L2 regulation, glutathione synthesis defects with methylglyoxal, or vitamin C/BH4/NAD metabolism.

name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, manganese or cadmium, distinguishing the theme from zinc, iron/heme and metallothionein-focused confusables.

name: Catecholamine biosynthesis and monoamine transporter reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/catecholamine synthesis, vesicular loading and SLC6 transporter reuptake of norepinephrine, dopamine and serotonin with their transporter defects, while confusables add serotonin synthesis or MAO/COMT degradation.

name: GABA and glycine inhibitory neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, secretion, reuptake and degradation, glycinergic transmission and its transporter defect, distinguishing the theme from glutamate/aspartate transport confusables.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 signalling, its attenuation and miRNA biogenesis
rationale: Members concern TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signalling, its downregulation, and SMAD-linked control of miRNA transcription and processing, unlike confusables on fibrosis, TGFBR3/activin, RUNX3 or BMP signalling.

name: Cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members cover centriole/basal body formation, intraflagellar transport, ciliary cargo targeting, axonemal dynein assembly and motile-cilium functions such as sperm motility and CSF flow, whereas confusables add sperm mitochondrial sheath, tubulin modification, photoreceptor or left-right patterning.

qualifier: primitive streak, EMT and mesendoderm migration
name: Gastrulation via primitive streak, EMT and mesendoderm migration
rationale: Members cover primitive streak formation, gastrulation EMT, mesendoderm development and mesodermal cell migration as pluripotency genes are released, unlike confusables on cardiac, lateral plate or endoderm specification.

name: Norepinephrine and epinephrine biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: All three members concern synthesis and metabolism of norepinephrine and epinephrine, distinguishing them from confusables on dopamine synthesis, monoamine degradation, transport or amino-acid neurotransmitters.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and breakdown, dopamine-DARPP-32 and CREB
name: Adenylate cyclase cAMP turnover and dopamine-DARPP-32 signalling
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis and PDE-mediated catabolism, D1-type dopamine and DARPP-32 signalling and CREB phosphorylation, while every confusable instead centres on PKA activation and cAMP responses.

name: Cardiac valve, septum and ventricular chamber morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum formation, trabeculation and chamber myocardium morphogenesis, whereas confusables address heart tube and secondary heart field specification, coronary vasculature or great arteries.

qualifier: telomere protection and replication fork stress
name: Telomere protection and replication fork stress responses
rationale: Members concern telomere capping and maintenance, fork reversal, R-loop and topological processing, intra-S checkpoint and responses to replication-stalling drugs, distinguishing the theme from double-strand break repair confusables.

name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members cover SLC transport of organic cations and anions, polyamines and xenobiotics including blood-brain barrier export, whereas confusables centre on SLCO anion transport, drug ADME and bilirubin handling.

qualifier: Th2 differentiation and IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 induction
name: Th2 cell differentiation and IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 induction
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, positive regulation of IL-4, IL-5 and IL-13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signalling with mast cell activation, unlike confusables on eosinophils, negative regulation and IgE switching, or IL-33.

name: TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation downstream of innate receptors
rationale: Members cover TRAF6-, IRAK2-, TRIF- and ALPK1-dependent activation of TAK1 and its activation of JNK and p38 stress kinases, whereas confusables centre on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB signalling.

name: Hexosamine biosynthesis and sialic acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose-6-phosphate conversion to UDP-GlcNAc, GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism and their GFPT1, GNE and ALG14 defects, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, dolichol-glucose or mannose metabolism.
